html:
Expert ENT Care in Silver Touch Hospitals

Ear, nose, and throat disorders can disturb your daily comfort, sleep, voice, and even balance. Silver Touch Hospitals‘ ENT department is dedicated to fast diagnosis and efficient treatment for a variety of ENT problems in adults as well as children.

Whether it is recurring ear infections, nasal blockage, sinusitis, throat discomfort or hearing issues, we are the ENT hospital in Ahmedabad equipped to make you breathe, hear and speak more easily.

Credible Ear Hospital in Ahmedabad

Being a known ear hospital in Ahmedabad, we diagnose and treat typical and rare conditions of the ear, such as:

  • Hearing loss and tinnitus
  • Recurrent ear infections
  • Disorders of balance and vertigo
  • Eardrum perforation
  • Foreign body removal

Audiometry and other sophisticated tests enable us to determine your hearing precisely and devise the next course of action.

Multispecialty ENT Hospital in Ahmedabad

The treatment extends beyond ear issues at our multispeciality ENT hospitals in Ahmedabad. We treat conditions such as:

  • Deviated nasal septum
  • Sinusitis and nasal polyps
  • Tonsillitis and adenoid problems
  • Vocal cord disorders
  • Sleep apnoea and snoring
  • Head and neck infections

We also screen for tumours, growths, or chronic infections that need surgery.

Our ENT specialists collaborate with radiologists and anaesthetists to provide safe outcomes, particularly when surgery is essential.

Best ENT Hospital in Ahmedabad with Advanced Treatment

Silver Touch Hospitals is regarded as one of the best ENT hospital in Ahmedabad due to its blend of clinical capabilities, surgical equipment, and ethical care.

Our ENT specialists carry out:

  • Ear tube insertion
  • Tonsillectomy and adenoidectomy
  • Correction of the nasal septum
  • Sinus surgeries through endoscopic methods
  • Micro laryngeal surgeries

Every procedure is done in our clean operation theatres with post-op recovery assistance.

Meet a Skilled ENT Doctor in Ahmedabad

If you or your child is suffering from persistent ENT symptoms, it’s time to meet an ENT doctor in Ahmedabad at Silver Touch Hospitals. Our experts take the time to explain your condition and walk you through treatment options, surgery or non-surgery, according to what works best for you.

faqs.q: Do you see children in the ENT clinic?
faqs.a: Yes, we have specialised ENT services for children, such as tonsillitis, adenoiditis, and ear infection treatment.

faqs.q: Can a hearing test be conducted here?
faqs.a: Yes. Our audiometry facility diagnoses hearing issues in all age groups.

faqs.q: Do I require a referral to see the ENT specialist?
faqs.a: No, no referral is required. You may simply book a consultation with our ENT specialists at your closest Silver Touch Hospitals facility.
